'''Thomkins Watam''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a chauffeur in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. He wore an all [[Color|black]] uniform including [[boot]]s, pants, [[glove]]s a shirt and a [[belt]] along with a formal pointed chauffeur's [[hat]]. His right glove was fitted with a concealed pocket to carry bribes. Watam had fair skin, brown [[hair]] and green [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thomkins Watam first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
